mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_family (name, creator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{creatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_family ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_family_member WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT f.id, f.name, f.creator_id, DATE_FORMAT(f.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS created_at, u.nickname AS creator_nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_family_member WHERE family_id = f.id) AS member_count FROM t_family f LEFT JOIN t_user u ON f.creator_id = u.id WHERE f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
